## Why This Is Asked

Assesses ability to design a tenant-isolated PKI workflow in Vault Enterprise, including per-tenant namespaces, per-tenant PKI engines, and automated rotation with auditable rollback.

## Key Concepts

- Vault Enterprise namespaces and per-tenant PKI engines
- Roles controlling certificate issuance and TTLs
- Per-tenant CRL distribution and trust anchors
- Audit integration and rollback strategies

## Code Example

```bash
vault namespace ns/tenant-abc
vault secrets enable -path=ns/tenant-abc/pki pki
vault write secret/ns/tenant-abc/pki/config/urls issuing_certificates="https://vault.example.com/ns/tenant-abc/pki/ca" crl_distribution_points="https://vault.example.com/ns/tenant-abc/pki/crl"
vault write secret/ns/tenant-abc/pki/roles/tenant_abc_tls allow_any_name=true allow_subdomains=true ttl="12h" max_ttl="24h"

```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you monitor PKI rotation latency and audit consistency?
- What steps would you take if a tenant’s CA is compromised and you must rotate it with zero downtime?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests KV v2 versioning, per-tenant isolation via policies, and practical onboarding steps with Vault CLI.

## Key Concepts
- KV v2 path scoping
- Policy creation and binding
- AppRole or token auth
- Rollback and isolation testing

## Code Example
```bash
vault secrets enable -path=tenant-<id> kv-v2
vault policy write tenant-admin-<id> - <<'EOF'
path "tenant-<id>/*" {
  capabilities = ["create","read","update","delete","list"]
}
EOF
vault policy write tenant-app-<id> - <<'EOF'
path "tenant-<id>/*" {
  capabilities = ["read","list"]
}
EOF
```

```bash
vault write auth/approle/role/tenant-app-<id> token_ttl=30m policies=tenant-app-<id>
vault kv put tenant-<id>/config/feature enabled=true
```

```bash
vault read kv/tenant-<id>/data/config/feature
```

```bash
# Rollback
vault token revoke <token>
vault delete auth/approle/role/tenant-app-<id>
vault delete policy/tenant-admin-<id>
vault erase kv/tenant-<id>
```

- How would you rotate the KV v2 versioning without downtime?
